summary: The enable condition is inverted, so the counter holds when en is asserted.
reasoning: The testbench increments its expected count when en is high (tb/counter_tb.v:10-12). After reset it sets en=1 (line 21), but the first enabled step reports expected=1 and actual=0. The RTL instead increments under !en. This is the most likely cause, though the proposed repair has not been validated.
